about: The one table of the fleet's model pools: every provider the lanes use, the quota or credit behind it, and where its reset or expiry is read from. Two rules live here. (1) Tim, 2026-11-11: Anthropic models (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, any claude-*) run only on the Claude subscription that is already paid for, or on Hyperagent; never the Vercel AI Gateway or a metered API key. (2) Among available routes of one capability class, the pool whose unused allowance is lost first takes the run. Read by scripts/lanes/model_pools.py: `check` is the CI guard, `command_guard` and `refusal` are the runtime checks, `balanced` is the selector, `utilization` is the per-pool summary. Product chat has its own fail-closed allowlist (apps/web/lib/ai/sdk.ts, JOV-7119). Summer carries the same Anthropic rule in JovieInc/summer-config apps/summer/agent/lib/model-pools.ts.

claude-subscription.label: Claude subscription (Claude Code sessions)

expiry.note: Local 5 hour run window from claude-quota.json, read only while a window is open; an idle lane has no expiry. The registry has no provider quota read path for the Claude subscription, so weekly reset data does not exist.

claude-subscription.quota: Flat-rate subscription; 5 hour usage window, soft cap from ops/registry/capacity.json anthropic-claude limits

hyperagent.label: Hyperagent credits (Founding 500)

expiry.note: Daily run cap (HYPERAGENT_RUNS_PER_DAY, per UTC day) and the credit expiry in ops/registry/capacity.json.

hyperagent.quota: Given credits (Founding 500) with a daily run cap (HYPERAGENT_RUNS_PER_DAY)

codex-subscription.label: OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT Pro seats)
codex-subscription.quota: Shared weekly subscription window per account

expiry.note: Earliest future resetsAt across active accounts, from the live overlay (capacity-live.json) or the registry snapshot. A reading whose reset is already past gives no expiry.

codex-subscription.fix: Codex seats run OpenAI models. Run Anthropic models on the Claude lane or on Hyperagent.

grok-subscription.label: xAI Grok (SuperGrok Heavy)
grok-subscription.quota: Weekly capped quota; promo price until 2026-12-01

expiry.note: Weekly resetsAt from the Grok usage reader (live overlay) or the registry snapshot.

grok-subscription.fix: Grok runs xAI models. Run Anthropic models on the Claude lane or on Hyperagent.

devin-free.label: Devin (free SWE-2)
devin-free.quota: Free tier, bounded by providers.json freeOnly.stopBefore

expiry.note: freeOnly.stopBefore on the lane. Once that date has passed there is no expiry to chase.

devin-free.fix: Devin runs its free model only. Run Anthropic models on the Claude lane or on Hyperagent.

kimi.label: Kimi plan
kimi.quota: Capped plan; status unverified in ops/registry/capacity.json

expiry.note: No reset or expiry is recorded for this plan.

kimi.fix: Kimi runs Moonshot models. Run Anthropic models on the Claude lane or on Hyperagent.

vercel-ai-gateway.label: Vercel AI Gateway (metered)
vercel-ai-gateway.fix: Run it on the Claude lane (scripts/lanes/claude_lane.py, subscription login) or on Hyperagent.

expiry.note: Pay per token: nothing is lost by not using it.

anthropic-api.label: Metered Anthropic API key
anthropic-api.fix: Remove the API key route. Run it on the Claude lane (subscription login) or on Hyperagent.

expiry.note: Pay per token: nothing is lost by not using it.

exceptions.reason: The Summer improvement loop is a Claude Managed Agents session on api.anthropic.com, paid from the monthly Claude API credit (ops/registry/spend.json managed-agents-loop, capped at $150 a month).
